name: Carl Gustavsson
source:
Carl Gustavsson or Gus the Bus, Gus, The Bus, Bus, Muscles, Little Bear (only his [url=/c176877]mother[/url] calls him that) is a small-time criminal with some untapped potential. He is much smarter than his partner in crime, [url=/c176663]Ringo[/url], will ever give him credit for. He also has a much clearer moral compass than most of his fellow outlaws do. Carl is impatient, intelligent, and loyal.

[Edited from in-game description]
